title: JuiceBox Session Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=juicebox:session
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by location
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>24
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when JuiceBox session data has stopped arriving for a given location.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per location and alert when the feed is older than 24 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It quickly when one part of your JuiceBox session feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
